name: No Ultra-High b-values
description: Ultra-high b-values (>=1000 s/mm²) are discouraged due to greater image distortions and the need for longer echo-times resulting in poor SNR. However, ultra-high b-value images may be extrapolated from source DWI images without scanner time penalty for detection and segmentation. (From the MY-RADS Myeloma Whole-Body MRI Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
b_values = value["DiffusionBValue"].dropna().unique()
b_values = [float(b) for b in b_values]

ultra_high = [b for b in b_values if b >= 1000]
if ultra_high:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Ultra-high b-values (>=1000) are discouraged due to image distortions and poor SNR. Found: {ultra_high}. Consider extrapolating from lower b-value source images instead.")

testCases.name: Boundary b=1000
testCases.description: b=1000 is at the ultra-high threshold
